sources.name: CC-CEDICT (MDBG export, 2026-11-03)
sources.licenceStatement: https://cc-cedict.org/wiki/ (read 2026-11-03): "CC-CEDICT is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 License." Official download: https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict.

method: tone-marked pinyin (one syllable per hanzi, numbered CC-CEDICT syllables converted to marks, neutral tone unmarked) and the traditional spelling per candidate-pool lemma (simplified) from CC-CEDICT; proper-name entries (capitalised pinyin) and entries that are not one syllable per hanzi are skipped. Confirmed when kaikki's pinyin (derived/readings.json) picks exactly one CC-CEDICT reading (tone-exact, else toneless — CC-CEDICT's tones are kept), or, without kaikki pinyin, when CC-CEDICT has exactly one reading. A reading whose entries spell the traditional form two ways is listed in `traditionalAmbiguous`. Everything else is listed in `unresolved` with its reason. The MDBG export changes daily: this pin is a 2026-11-03 retrieval, newer than the pool's 2026-10-14 pin in source-manifest.json.
